dvskin.title: DV Skin
dvskin.none.skin: Your own Minecraft skin is used, with the arm model of your account.
dvskin.none.cape: No DV cape. If you have a real Mojang cape, it stays.
dvskin.none.elytra: The elytra uses your cape's picture, as in vanilla.
dvskin.hint.file: Or drop a PNG on this window. Skins: 64×64 or 64×32. Capes and elytra: 64×32.
dvskin.hint.mojang: The skin of a Minecraft account, by player name.
dvskin.hint.elyby: The skin of an Ely.by account, by player name.
dvskin.hint.url: A direct link to a PNG picture (for example copied from a skin site).
dvskin.hint.dv: Capes drawn for the DV mods.
dvskin.status.loaded: Loaded. Press Apply to use it.
dvskin.status.saved: Saved. You'll wear it in every world and on every server.
dvskin.local_only: This server doesn't have DV Skin: only you see your choice.
dvskin.error.empty: Type a name or a link first.
dvskin.error.no_skin: That player has no skin of their own.
dvskin.error.invalid: That isn't a PNG picture, or it can't be read.
dvskin.error.size: Wrong size: skins are 64×64 or 64×32, capes and elytra 64×32.
dvskin.error.network: Couldn't download it. Check the name or link and your connection.
dvskin.error.bad_url: That isn't a web link (http or https).
dvskin.error.namemc: NameMC doesn't allow downloads from games. Press Download on its page, then pick the file with the File source.
dvskin.result.no_skins: This server doesn't share skins; others see your own skin.
dvskin.result.no_capes: This server doesn't share capes; others don't see your cape or elytra.
dvskin.result.nothing: This server shares neither skins nor capes.
dvskin.result.too_fast: Too fast; sending again in a moment.
